verdicts.note: Limits, last sentence: "The wording does not name divisors or prime numbers." The Dutch is "onderzoeken van eigenschappen van en relaties tussen getallen tot ten minste 1000: even en oneven, veelvouden, de rol van de 'nul' in getallen, reeksen": "eigenschappen van en relaties tussen getallen" is a general term inside which divisors and prime numbers fall (a divisor is the other side of "veelvouden"), and the same Limits says the wording "does not say whether the list is complete". Singling two subjects out as not named reads as a limit the wording does not have. Say that four subjects are listed after the colon and no other is singled out.
